overview: This Senate resolution honors the life of NASCAR driver Kyle Busch, who died on May 21, 2026, at age 41. It traces his career from go-kart racing in Las Vegas to two NASCAR Cup Series championships, wins at major races, and a record 234 victories across NASCAR's three national series, the most of any driver. It also notes the race team he founded, his popularity with fans, and his role as a father mentoring his son in racing. The resolution expresses the Senate's sorrow and asks that it be shared with the House. It does not change any law. As of June 17, 2026, the Senate had approved it.
for: Supporters say it appropriately honors one of the most accomplished drivers in motorsports history and recognizes his family's loss.
against: Critics say it is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
